name: UTS Interest-Free Student Loan
summary: Interest-free loan for enrolled UTS students facing short-term cash flow problems.
key: Up to a $3,000 balance at any one time, with no interest charges.
who: Currently enrolled, continuing UTS student (international students must be onshore)
90 days of transactions for each Australian bank account
how: Apply online in the student portal under Financial Assistance Application
For urgent needs call SSU reception on 02 9514 1177
catches: Must be fully repaid before you complete your course; repayments can be deferred 3 months then spread over 3, 6 or 12 months
Not open to UTS College, non-award, inbound exchange or leave-of-absence students
First-session students can apply only after census date
